intro: You have found a yeti hide that may well be perfect: remarkably thick and tough, beyond what the yetis of Rage Scar yield. At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider is looking for yeti hides.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have found what may very well be a perfect yeti hide. You easily note that it is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar.
Considering that Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What's this, friend - you've got something special for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is an incredible find! I believe this is the finest yeti hide specimen I have ever seen!

Indeed, this is certainly worthy of an appropriate bounty. I normally don't pay that much for a single hide, but I'm confident I can make something special from it. Thanks for thinking of me on this, friend!
